name: Meh official daily deal RSS
scope: One daily deal published by Meh; US-focused and not assumed to be globally eligible
notes: Official retailer RSS feed. Imported items enter data/inbox.json as pending_review only. Editors must verify current terms, eligible countries, fees, stock, and redemption before publishing.

name: eBay Buy Feed API
scope: Discount and promotion feeds for supported marketplaces
notes: Requires an eligible eBay developer application, OAuth access, marketplace support, and compliance with API terms. Do not enable until credentials and permissions are approved.

name: Flipkart Affiliate Offers API
scope: Flipkart offers and deals of the day
notes: Regional coverage only. Requires affiliate registration, API access, affiliate ID, and token.

name: Official merchant and organizer pages
scope: Rewards, competitions, loyalty programmes, store offers, and coupons
notes: An editor verifies the original merchant or organizer page, eligible countries, validity, fees, and redemption rules before publishing.
